semantic_split_units.content: The research contract preserves an earlier ASI-0 state in which the canonical scientific outcome had not yet been executed. This is developmental provenance and must not be overwritten by later closure records.
The later current-state record closes ASI-0 with the canonical primary outcome C=0 and A=0 under the frozen protected-acceptance policy, producing STOP rather than replication authorization.

The repository separates pre-outcome nonclaims from later bounded results; claims remain local to the tested assay, estimator, representation, and provenance layer and do not authorize broad intelligence or intrinsic-complexity conclusions.

ASI-0 attempt #1 with the Boolean-pair domain fails constructively before outcome-bearing model execution because the finite domain cannot supply the frozen number of unique development plus concealed prompts. Y is not produced; this is not a scientific negative.

The Boolean-triple repair is prospective and changes only the finite Boolean input domain while preserving canonical assignment, estimands, protected regressions, seeds, inference, and replication logic.

Persisted repair validation reports PASS for truth-table, uniqueness, disjointness, hash/answer, misalignment, and synthetic scoring checks, while explicitly marking scientific_result=false and repair_validation_only=true.

CPU diagnostic output is a non-scientific behavioral reference used to test exact parsed-output equivalence of the final CUDA diagnostic path; equivalence is an execution gate, not a scientific endpoint.

Canonical ASI-0 primary records C=0 and A=0, the joint gate is not satisfied, classification is STOP, and no replication is authorized. This is a persisted source-reported scientific negative whose execution provenance is bounded unless independently witnessed.

Post-outcome diagnosis leaves the canonical scientific result unchanged and uses selection identity plus protected-regression records rather than concealed test performance to localize throughput failure.
Candidate-pool protected-regression pass capacity and realized aligned/misaligned selection/admission rates are distinct quantities and must not be conflated.

B0-v2 defines a candidate conversational-state interface for plumbing only; a plumbing PASS can justify freezing a later manipulation-validation test but is not itself manipulation validity or B1 outcome evidence.

B0 tests whether matched E0/EU/EV signals move reported probability P_POST relative to frozen P_PRE while forbidding answer revision and correctness scoring; it is a manipulation/measurement test only.

B1 is a separately frozen outcome experiment that preserves the repaired conversational state and allows one revision opportunity; B0 manipulation validity may authorize B1 but does not count as B1 evidence.
A7 prospectively crosses prior-state encoding with section scaffold while retaining E0/EV, using a fresh 2x2 representation interaction rather than post-hoc decomposition.

Pilot-0 closes through a sequence of measurement, localization, manipulation, outcome, and replication gates; diagnostic success is not revision-governance or adaptation success, and interface diagnosis is not interface invention.
R1 fresh-cohort replication preserves a nonzero causal effect of prior-state encoding on T_instability under the frozen labeled-scaffold E0-only contrast.
The replicated encoding-to-instability effect remains entirely within the inherited plus/minus 0.05 practical scale, so causal nonzero status does not imply practical largeness.

Pilot-1 predictive-resource experiments compare fixed finite estimator families under frozen resource schedules; any A-vs-N excess is descriptive estimator burden and not intrinsic adaptive representational complexity.
The initial fixed-estimator run reports a descriptive adaptive-versus-nonadaptive structural prediction excess that authorizes stronger identification controls, not an intrinsic-complexity claim.
Match1 strengthens identification by matching exact initial system states while leaving true dynamics unchanged; the earlier ridge excess disappears under the stronger matched/oracle control.

ID1 evaluates N/A system identification across polynomial ridge degrees, resources, IID and structural holdouts; high-resource excess at a fixed degree remains descriptive and can authorize stronger estimator tests only.

The stronger P3 identification test collapses the earlier residual, and a fresh-seed replication reverses its sign; finite-estimator burden therefore does not earn promotion to intrinsic adaptive complexity.

Future-plasticity G0-G3 forecasting treats forecastability as predictive rather than causal; failure of these model comparisons cannot establish intrinsic unpredictability, and G4-G6 remain unauthorized.

Synthetic assay references exercise estimator, measurement, randomization, plasticity, and representation failure modes as development evidence only; they are not empirical evidence about real systems.

Threshold and rare-jump worlds are synthetic stress tests showing that order-based treatment-response structure can differ from a linear interaction summary and that mean effects need not identify jump probability versus jump value.
Benchmark seed cases are internal development/specification material; repeated seed/example records do not constitute independently executed research cases or independent warrants.
Example evaluation records are explicitly illustrative/example-only and cannot be promoted to verified executions or scientific results.

The final ASI-0 shell path uses fail-closed sequencing: a CUDA diagnostic behavioral-equivalence gate runs first and canonical outcome execution is invoked only if the gate exits successfully; source code for this path is not itself proof the outcome run executed.

split_rule: same source location may yield multiple semantic units; semantic split != textual independence != warrant independence
